# NeuMarry

> NeuMarry is a verified matrimony app for people living away from the country they grew up in, from every country and community. Members match on values, lifestyle, roots and distance, and meet with their families at hosted Family Mixer evenings. Launching in Toronto, Canada in November 2026; the app works in every country.

Key facts:
- Every member verifies a government ID and a live selfie, and proves their roots and the city they live in, before others can see them.
- No income, salary or wealth requirement for anyone, men or women. NeuMarry is not Knot.dating and has no Rs 50 lakh rule.
- Not only for Indians: open to people of every country and community, matched with people of their own roots.
- Free: profile, verification, number of people who fit you and your match % with each. Gold (from CA$80 a month) adds names, photos, interests and chat.
- Web app: https://neumarry.com/app/ . Android app on Google Play; iPhone later. App languages: English and French.
- For adults 18 and over looking for marriage. Not a casual dating app.

- [Free and Gold](https://neumarry.com/pricing.html): What NeuMarry costs: joining, verification and match % are free. Gold shows names, photos, interests and chat from CA$80 a month. Event tickets are separate.
- [Privacy and safety](https://neumarry.com/privacy-and-safety.html): How NeuMarry keeps you safe: ID and live selfie checks, photos hidden until you both accept, no phone numbers shown, block and report reviewed by a person.

- [Is this profile real?](https://neumarry.com/is-this-profile-real.html): Free check for matrimony and dating profiles: 10 quick questions show the warning signs of a fake profile or romance scam. No sign-up. Share it with family.
- [Sample verified profile](https://neumarry.com/sample-verified-profile.html): See how a fully verified NeuMarry profile looks: 5 checks done by a person, why you match, shared roots and distance. This is a sample, not a real member.
